claim_rule_evaluation.order_signal_verdict: Order carries detectable predictive signal beyond the shuffled-order null at the tactic level (Holm-adjusted p=0.0180), but order signal is not distinguishable from the shuffled-order null at the technique level (Holm-adjusted p=0.7712).
claim_rule_evaluation.rationale: Under the pre-registered claim rule, an improvement over the baseline is not demonstrated because: (1) At the technique level (P2), although the McNemar difference is statistically significant (Holm-adjusted p=0.0094), pooled Markov Hit@3 (0.0316) is lower than Frequency Hit@3 (0.1684), favoring the baseline; and (2) At the tactic level (P1), pooled Markov Hit@3 (0.6316) equals Frequency Hit@3 (0.6316) with Holm-adjusted p=1.0000.
claim_rule_evaluation.rule: improvement over the baseline demonstrated requires pooled Markov Hit@3 > Frequency Hit@3 AND Holm-adjusted p < 0.05 for at least one level; otherwise not demonstrated
